description: Make the signed-in account private: other users stop seeing its trades, balance, rank and record. Only call this when the person asked for it in this conversation. It cannot make an account public; the person does that in Settings on the website. Accounts are private by default, so this is often already the state (changed: false).

confirm.description: true, after the person asked for it.

private.description: Always true: this tool only makes an account private.

name: set_privacy
title: Make the account private
